intent: Add a public static method is_hpos_enabled() to the Woodev_Test_Shipping_Zones class in includes/class-woodev-test-shipping-zones.php. It returns true when WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage is active, detected via class_exists on \Automattic\WooCommerce\Utilities\OrderUtil and that class's custom_orders_table_usage_is_enabled() method, and false otherwise (including when WooCommerce is not loaded). Document it with a WordPress-style docblock. Change nothing else.
rationale: A WooCommerce-facing change whose correct implementation needs domain knowledge (a guarded class_exists before calling into OrderUtil), not just syntax. It is the case that would catch a critic tuned so tight that any real-world integration code reads as risky -- the balance adr/005 formalized: correctness is the critic's job, coverage is not.
